item.title: Hime no Rakuen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Succulent
  • 発売日: 2023-12-30
  • スコア: 5.66/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 姫の楽園
  • 英語名: Hime no Rakuen

别名

  • Hime no Rakuen

あらすじ

Since successfully developing powerful magic, the empire has continued to wage wars against neighboring countries to expand its territory.

Due to something as a dividing line, the empire’s princess Canaria and her attendant Iora were driven to live in an isolation hut.

In her boring daily life, Canaria accidentally saw prisoners of the neighboring knights being brought into the city.
